info.name: Get all activities accessible to the user

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of activities to return

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of activities to skip before collecting results

params.name: investingEntityIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include activities belonging to one of the Investing Entity ids in the provided argument

params.name: issuingEntityIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include activities belonging to one of the Issuing Entity ids in the provided argument

params.name: accountIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include holdings relevant to one of the account ids in the provided argument

params.name: types
params.description: Will filter the output to only include activities with one of the types in the provided argument

params.name: beforeStatementDate
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a statement date before the queried timestamp.

params.name: afterStatementDate
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a statement date after the queried date.

params.name: beforeCreatedAt
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a creation time before the queried timestamp.

params.name: afterCreatedAt
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a creation time after the queried timestamp.

params.name: beforeDueAt
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a due time before the queried timestamp.

params.name: afterDueAt
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a due time after the queried timestamp.

params.name: beforeProcessedAt
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a processed time before the queried timestamp.

params.name: afterProcessedAt
params.description: Filter the output for activities with a processed time after the queried timestamp.

params.name: holdingIds
params.description: Filter the output for activities related to holdings with ids in the provided argument

params.name: includeSummaries
params.description: Whether to include AI summaries in the data. Please contact Arch to enable this parameter.

params.name: hasSummaries
params.description: Filter the output for activities that have an AI summary if true, or activities that don't have an AI summary if false. Please contact Arch to enable this parameter.

params.name: includeCashFlow
params.description: Whether to include the cash flow associated with the activity, if it exists

params.name: includeEmailBodies
params.description: Whether to include the email body and html associated with the activity

params.name: includeApprovalStatus
params.description: Whether to include whether the activity is Pending/Approved. Please contact Arch to enable this parameter.

items.docs: Returns a list of all activities available to the user determined by the access token.
